title: pinalia sharmae
intro: Pinalia sharmae, commonly known as the White Potala Orchid, is an endangered orchid species native to the Western Ghats of India. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, where it has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pinalia sharmae include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in treating fever, cold, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
